title: Hydraglow Daily Gel Cleanser
shortDescription: A weightless gel-to-foam cleanser that dissolves sunscreen and makeup without that tight, squeaky finish.
description:
Hydraglow starts as a clear gel and melts into a low-foaming cream the moment it meets water, lifting SPF, sebum and pollution in one pass.

Built around glycerin and panthenol, it cleans at skin-friendly pH 5.5 so your barrier stays intact — no tightness, no rebound oiliness by midday.
howToUse: Massage a coin-sized amount onto damp skin morning and night. Rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry.

title: Clarifying Cream Cleanser
shortDescription: A cushioning cream wash for dry and reactive skin that cleanses without foaming agents.
description:
Formulated without sulfates or drying alcohols, this cream cleanser wraps skin in oat lipids and squalane while it works.

Ideal as the second step of a double cleanse, or as a standalone morning wash for skin that runs tight.
howToUse: Apply to dry or damp skin, massage for 30 seconds, then rinse or remove with a soft cloth.

title: Rose Balance Hydrating Toner
shortDescription: An alcohol-free rose and glycerin toner that rehydrates and preps skin in one swipe.
description:
A watery-light essence-toner hybrid: damascena rose water calms visible redness while three molecular weights of hyaluronic acid pull moisture into the upper layers.

Leaves skin plump and slightly tacky — the ideal canvas for a serum.
howToUse: Sweep over clean skin with hands or a cotton pad, then follow with serum while still damp.

title: AHA Renewal Serum 10%
shortDescription: A 10% glycolic and lactic blend that resurfaces dullness and unclogs texture overnight.
description:
Ten percent free acid at pH 3.8 — strong enough to visibly refine texture and fade post-blemish marks, buffered with allantoin so it stays tolerable.

Use at night, and pair with daily SPF: AHAs increase photosensitivity.
howToUse: Apply 3–4 drops at night on clean, dry skin. Start twice weekly and build up. Always wear SPF the next morning.

title: Vitamin C Brightening Serum
shortDescription: 15% stabilised vitamin C with ferulic acid for measurably brighter, more even tone.
description:
A stabilised L-ascorbic acid system at 15%, buffered with ferulic acid and vitamin E to slow oxidation and extend antioxidant protection through the day.

Expect visibly brighter tone in four weeks and fading of sun-induced pigment by twelve.
howToUse: Apply 4 drops each morning to clean skin, before moisturiser and sunscreen.

title: Peptide Firming Concentrate
shortDescription: A five-peptide complex that supports firmness and softens the look of fine lines.
description:
Matrixyl, copper tripeptide and three supporting peptides in a lightweight, silicone-free base.

A slow performer — this is a twelve-week product, not a twelve-day one.
howToUse: Press 3 drops into skin morning and night, before heavier creams.

title: Barrier Repair Moisturizer
shortDescription: A ceramide and cholesterol cream that rebuilds a compromised moisture barrier.
description:
Three ceramides, cholesterol and free fatty acids in the physiological ratio your skin actually uses to rebuild itself.

Rich but not occlusive — it settles matte enough to wear under makeup.
howToUse: Apply as the final step of your evening routine, or under SPF in the morning.

title: Featherlight Gel Cream
shortDescription: An oil-free gel cream for humid days and skin that hates heavy textures.
description:
Water-gel base with 2% niacinamide and sodium hyaluronate. Absorbs in seconds and leaves no film.

Built for oily and combination skin, and for anyone whose winter cream stops working in July.
howToUse: Smooth over face and neck morning and night after serum.

title: Overnight Recovery Mask
shortDescription: A leave-on sleeping mask that floods dehydrated skin and seals it in until morning.
description:
A cushiony gel-balm you apply as the last step twice a week. Urea and glycerin draw water in; a light occlusive veil keeps it there for eight hours.

You wake up with skin that looks rested rather than merely moisturised.
howToUse: Apply a generous layer 2–3 nights a week as your final step. No need to rinse.

title: Invisible Daily Sunscreen SPF50
shortDescription: Broad-spectrum SPF50 with a weightless finish and genuinely no white cast.
description:
A modern filter system that spreads like a serum and dries down invisible on every skin tone.

Photostable for the full day and cosmetically pleasant enough that you will actually reapply it.
howToUse: Apply two finger-lengths as the last step of your morning routine. Reapply every two hours in direct sun.
